chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Season on the steamer St. Paul and picking up Stuff Smith
summary: They play the whole season on the St. Paul, with Stuff Smith picked up in Ohio and Swazey back.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Weren't you guys hired to play--you weren't hired to play that whole season on the steamer, were you?
The J.S., I believe it was.
No; we were on the St. Paul.

And they took the name J.S.--that was the name of one of the boats that they had. That stayed down in New Orleans I think most of the time. The one that we were on, the St. Paul, we played the whole season--
There should have been some pictures made of that--
There should have been some, but that's when we had Stuff Smith.
Is this where you picked up Stuff or before you came to St. Louis?
Before we came into St. Louis, we picked up Stuff and then Swazey came
in the band. Swazey came back to the band?
Yeah; right. On the steamer St. Paul, we had Stuff Smith and Swazey.
